name: Bird of Passage
source:
Bird of Passage is a free night ride across Tokyo. 

By playing it, you will be granted access to the private conversations between a quirky passenger and the taxi drivers he will encounter en route.

Listen carefully and help him find his path...

[From [url=https://spacebackyard.itch.io/bird-of-passage]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Bird of Passage是穿越东京的免费夜间骑行。

通过玩这个游戏，你将能够接触到一位古怪的乘客和他在途中遇到的出租车司机之间的私人对话。

仔细聆听并帮助他找到自己的道路……

[来自[url=https://spacebackyard.itch.io/bird-of-passage]itch.io[/url]]
